main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 10-bar forward return on recorded 20-bar return, in-regime grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 and supporting difference > 0; reject if slope t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return, positive-forecast minus zero-forecast cases

decided_by: The slope t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Spread above 0 is read from the regime column being 'trending'. The coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over all grid bars of all its windows. The regressor is the raw mom20 last_history_value, and the forecast groups use the forecast on the same grid bars.
